name: earthquake_search
description: Search recent/historical earthquakes from USGS by time window, magnitude range and geographic area (circle or bbox). Returns observed events with UTC time, magnitude, depth, location, tsunami flag and USGS URL.

http.note: replace <preview-host> with the deployed God's Eye host; the route is served by the api/[...route].js catch-all

input_schema.title: earthquake_search input
input_schema.description: All fields are optional query parameters forwarded to the USGS FDSN Event Web Service `query` (or `count`) method. A circle search (`latitude` + `longitude` + `maxradiuskm`) and a bounding-box search (`minlatitude`/`maxlatitude`/`minlongitude`/`maxlongitude`) are mutually exclusive — supplying keys from both is a 400 error, and a partial circle (e.g. `latitude` without `maxradiuskm`) is also a 400 error.

starttime.description: Limit to events on or after this time (UTC). Accepts `YYYY-MM-DD` or `YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS(Z)`; a date with no time means midnight UTC.

endtime.description: Limit to events on or before this time (UTC). Same accepted formats as `starttime`.

latitude.description: Circle-search center latitude, degrees. Requires `longitude` and `maxradiuskm` together.

longitude.description: Circle-search center longitude, degrees. Requires `latitude` and `maxradiuskm` together.

maxradiuskm.description: Circle-search radius, kilometers (max is USGS's own limit, half the Earth's circumference). Requires `latitude` and `longitude` together.

minlatitude.description: Bounding-box south edge, degrees. Must be <= `maxlatitude`.

maxlatitude.description: Bounding-box north edge, degrees. Must be >= `minlatitude`.

minlongitude.description: Bounding-box west edge, degrees. Must be <= `maxlongitude`.

maxlongitude.description: Bounding-box east edge, degrees. Must be >= `minlongitude`.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return. USGS itself allows up to 20000; this adapter caps it at 200. Defaults to 100.

orderby.description: Sort order for the returned events.

mode.description: Local switch (not forwarded to USGS): 'query' returns matching events, 'count' returns only the number of matching events (uses the FDSN `count` endpoint).

output_schema.title: earthquake_search output
output_schema.description: Success body for mode=query (default). For mode=count, `events` is omitted and `count` alone reflects the number of matching events.

count.description: Number of events returned (mode=query) or matched (mode=count).

retrieved_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC time this route fetched the data.

url.description: The exact upstream request URL, including format=geojson and all forwarded params.

generated.description: ISO-8601 UTC time USGS generated the response (from GeoJSON metadata.generated).

license.const: USGS data are in the public domain (https://www.usgs.gov/information-policies-and-instructions/copyrights-and-credits)

query.description: The request's own query parameters, exactly as forwarded from the HTTP layer into the adapter.

info.title: God's Eye View — earthquake.search
info.description: USGS FDSN Event Web Service earthquake search, proxied by God's Eye View.

get.description: Search recent/historical earthquakes from USGS by time window, magnitude range and geographic area (circle or bbox). Returns observed events with UTC time, magnitude, depth, location, tsunami flag and USGS URL.

parameters.name: latitude
parameters.description: Circle center latitude; requires longitude + maxradiuskm.

parameters.name: longitude
parameters.description: Circle center longitude; requires latitude + maxradiuskm.

parameters.name: maxradiuskm
parameters.description: Circle radius km; requires latitude + longitude.

parameters.name: minlatitude
parameters.description: Bbox south edge; mutually exclusive with the circle params.

parameters.name: maxlatitude
parameters.description: Bbox north edge; mutually exclusive with the circle params.

parameters.name: minlongitude
parameters.description: Bbox west edge; mutually exclusive with the circle params.

parameters.name: maxlongitude
parameters.description: Bbox east edge; mutually exclusive with the circle params.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.description: Local switch; 'count' uses the FDSN count endpoint instead of query. Not forwarded to USGS.

200.description: Matching earthquakes (or their count, if mode=count).

400.description: Invalid query — unknown parameter, out-of-range value, or mixed circle/bbox.

504.description: USGS did not respond in time, or was unreachable, after one retry.
